name: gohighlevel
description: Search contacts, conversations, opportunities, and calendars in a HighLevel sub-account.

GHL_PRIVATE_INTEGRATION_TOKEN.title: HighLevel Private Integration Token
GHL_PRIVATE_INTEGRATION_TOKEN.description: Token created in the sub-account under Settings → Private Integrations, with the scopes the MCP tools need. Starts with "pit-".

GHL_LOCATION_ID.title: HighLevel location ID
GHL_LOCATION_ID.description: ID of the sub-account (location) the token belongs to, from Settings → Business Profile.
